title: Customer onboarding
text:
Aster Support runs a 30-day onboarding program for new enterprise customers. The onboarding owner is the customer success manager. The program begins with a kickoff call and a written success plan.

During the first week, the customer success manager agrees on milestones with the customer. At day 30, the manager reviews adoption and transfers unresolved issues to support.

title: Incident escalation
text:
Aster Support classifies a complete production outage as severity 1. The on-call incident commander must be paged within 10 minutes of confirming a severity 1 outage.

The incident commander posts customer updates every 30 minutes until service is restored. After the incident, the team publishes a post-incident review within 2 business days.

title: Security and access
text:
Aster Support requires multi-factor authentication for all staff with access to customer data. Privileged access is reviewed by the security team every 90 days.

Employees must report suspected credential exposure to the security team immediately. The security team revokes compromised credentials and coordinates the investigation.

title: Refund policy
text:
Aster Support offers a full refund for an annual subscription cancelled within 14 days of purchase. The billing team handles refund requests.

After the 14-day window, annual subscriptions are not automatically refundable. The billing team may review exceptional cases but approval is not guaranteed.

title: Data retention
text:
Aster Support retains customer support tickets for 18 months after closure. The privacy team owns requests to delete customer data.

Backups are retained for 30 days. Deletion from backups occurs when those backups expire, rather than immediately.
